import json,time
from evaluation.catalogue import sources,FORMATS
from engine.resize import resize
cases=[(s,dict(width=w,height=h)) for _,s in sources() for w,h in FORMATS.values()]
for s,t in cases: resize(s,t)
times=[]
for _ in range(5):
 start=time.perf_counter()
 for s,t in cases:resize(s,t)
 times.append(time.perf_counter()-start)
print(json.dumps({'cases':len(cases),'warm_sweep_seconds':times}))
